A '''snoop-cam''' was a video surveillance device used for covert operations.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] used a snoop-cam to spy on a meeting between [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[J'oopi Shé/Legends|J'oopi Shé]], and three [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] from the [[Delegation of 2000]], as the menagerie had taken audio counter-surveillance measures.
